annotations.title: Resolve a QR code, GTIN or product page

description: Use this when someone pastes or scans what is printed on a label or package: a ProofPass QR link (/q/…), a GS1 Digital Link (/01/<gtin>), a bare GTIN or a ProofPass product page address. Resolves what is printed on a label or pasted from a browser to the public product: a ProofPass QR link or its 7-character code (/q/<code>), a GTIN or GS1 Digital Link (/01/<gtin>), a product page address or "manufacturer-slug/product-slug". Returns the identifiers and every current document exactly as the public product page shows them; hidden products, unchecked or paused manufacturers and archived versions are never returned. Do not use for a free-text product name (use search_products) or for products in the person's own account (use get_my_product).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product.description: QR link or code, GTIN, GS1 Digital Link, product page URL, "manufacturer-slug/product-slug" or a product id from search_products
